description: Traffic Signal Projects is a dataset listed in City of Austin open data portal (datahub.austintexas.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Austin. This dataset is currently under construction and subject to change at any time. The records in this dataset do not reflect actual business records and have been created for demonstration purposes only. Coverage: Austin. The portal files it under the category Transportation and Mobility. The table has 10 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Austin, Texas - data.austintexas.gov. The portal shows 2021-09-14 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datahub-austintexas-gov-portal.
